cards.card_text: Then God hands Noah the building plans: gopher wood, rooms, pitch inside and out, a roof, a door in the side, three decks, and 300 cubits long.
cards.verse_text: And this is how you are to build it: The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
cards.snippet: …how you are to build it: The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.

cards.card_text: The waters rise and cover the mountaintops fifteen cubits deep.
cards.verse_text: The waters rose and covered the mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.
cards.snippet: The waters rose and covered the mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.

cards.card_text: Next God lays out an altar of acacia wood, square, five cubits on each side and three cubits high.
cards.verse_text: The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
cards.snippet: The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.

cards.card_text: Then God marks out a courtyard with walls of fine linen on posts, a hundred cubits on the north and south and fifty on the west.
cards.verse_text: On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
cards.snippet: …side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and…

cards.card_text: Next comes a small square altar of acacia wood, a cubit long and a cubit wide.
cards.verse_text: It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high.
cards.snippet: It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high.

cards.card_text: Bezalel builds the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood, square, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high.
cards.verse_text: It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
cards.snippet: It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.

cards.card_text: Then he builds the courtyard all around, with curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits on the south and north sides and fifty on the west and east.
cards.verse_text: The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
cards.snippet: The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen, with twenty posts and…

cards.card_text: The wind brings the quail down near the camp, about two cubits above the ground.
cards.verse_text: Now a wind sent by the LORD came up, drove in quail from the sea, and brought them near the camp, about two cubits above the surface of the ground, for a day’s journey in every direction around the camp.
cards.snippet: …quail from the sea, and brought them near the camp, about two cubits above the surface of the ground, for a day’s journey in every…

cards.card_text: The pasturelands are for the Levites' herds, flocks and other livestock, and they're measured out in cubits from the city wall on every side.
cards.verse_text: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
cards.snippet: …the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.

cards.card_text: His bed, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, was still in Rabbah of the Ammonites when this was written.
cards.verse_text: His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)
cards.snippet: His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)

cards.card_text: The officers also tell the people to stay about two thousand cubits back from the ark.
cards.verse_text: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark.
cards.snippet: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark.

cards.card_text: But Ehud has also made himself a double-edged sword, a cubit long, and he hides it under his cloak.
cards.verse_text: Now Ehud had made for himself a double-edged sword a cubit long.
cards.snippet: Now Ehud had made for himself a double-edged sword a cubit long.

cards.card_text: Then a champion walks out of the Philistine camp: Goliath, from Gath, six cubits and a span tall.
cards.verse_text: He was six cubits and a span in height,
cards.snippet: He was six cubits and a span in height,

cards.card_text: Up goes the house: sixty cubits long, with a porch out front, narrow windows up high, and three floors of side rooms all along it, roofed with cedar.
cards.verse_text: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
cards.snippet: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.

cards.card_text: With Amaziah captured, Jehoash goes to Jerusalem and breaks down four hundred cubits of the wall, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
cards.verse_text: Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section of four hundred cubits.
cards.snippet: …from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section of four hundred cubits.

cards.card_text: Each pillar stood eighteen cubits tall.
cards.verse_text: Each pillar was eighteen cubits tall.
cards.snippet: Each pillar was eighteen cubits tall.

cards.card_text: Then there's an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall, holding a spear like a weaver's beam, and Benaiah goes against him with a club.
cards.verse_text: He also struck down an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall.
cards.snippet: He also struck down an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall.

cards.card_text: Solomon breaks ground on the second day of the second month of his fourth year, on a foundation sixty cubits long and twenty wide, by the old standard.
cards.verse_text: The foundation that Solomon laid for the house of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide, according to the old standard.
cards.snippet: The foundation that Solomon laid for the house of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide, according to the old standard.

cards.card_text: Out front, he makes two pillars, thirty-five cubits high together, with chainwork on top and a hundred pomegranates fastened into it.
cards.verse_text: In front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits high, each with a capital on top measuring five cubits.
cards.snippet: …front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits high, each with a capital on top measuring five cubits.

cards.card_text: Now the furnishings, starting with a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty wide and ten HIGH.
cards.verse_text: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
cards.snippet: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

cards.card_text: Then he makes the Sea of cast metal: round, ten cubits rim to rim, five high, with two rows of ox figures cast right below the rim.
cards.verse_text: It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
cards.snippet: It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in…

cards.card_text: Then Solomon stands before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly, up on a bronze platform he had made, five cubits long, five wide and three high.
cards.verse_text: Now Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high and had placed it in the middle of the courtyard.
cards.snippet: Now Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high and had placed it…

cards.card_text: A gallows fifty cubits high A prison next to the gate A tower over the city wall
cards.verse_text: His wife Zeresh and all his friends told him, “Have them build a gallows fifty cubits high, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged on it.
cards.snippet: …and all his friends told him, “Have them build a gallows fifty cubits high, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged…

cards.card_text: He says there's a gallows fifty cubits high at Haman's house.
cards.verse_text: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs attending the king, said: “There is a gallows fifty cubits high at Haman’s house.
cards.snippet: …of the eunuchs attending the king, said: “There is a gallows fifty cubits high at Haman’s house.

cards.card_text: Next the man measures the inner court: square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred wide, with the altar in front of the temple.
cards.verse_text: It was square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide.
cards.snippet: It was square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide.

cards.card_text: Now the man brings him into the outer sanctuary and measures it: forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
cards.verse_text: Then the man brought me into the outer sanctuary and measured the side pillars to be six cubits wide on each side.
cards.snippet: …into the outer sanctuary and measured the side pillars to be six cubits wide on each side.

cards.card_text: Next the man goes into the inner sanctuary and measures a room twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
cards.verse_text: Then he measured the room adjacent to the inner sanctuary to be twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
cards.snippet: …he measured the room adjacent to the inner sanctuary to be twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.

cards.card_text: Then that measuring rod gets BUSY: side rooms in three levels of thirty rooms each, a building out back, and the whole temple a hundred cubits long.
cards.verse_text: Next he measured the wall of the temple to be six cubits thick, and the width of each side room around the temple was four cubits.
cards.snippet: Next he measured the wall of the temple to be six cubits thick, and the width of each side room around the temple was…

cards.card_text: Then Ezekiel sees an altar made of wood, three cubits high.
cards.verse_text: There was an altar of wood three cubits high and two cubits square.
cards.snippet: There was an altar of wood three cubits high and two cubits square.

cards.card_text: When the man finishes measuring the inside of the temple area, he leads Ezekiel out by the east gate and measures all four sides with his rod: east, five hundred cubits; north, five hundred; south, five hundred.
cards.verse_text: Now when the man had finished measuring the interior of the temple area, he led me out by the gate that faced east, and he measured the area all around: With a measuring rod he measured the east side to be five hundred cubits long.
cards.snippet: …a measuring rod he measured the east side to be five hundred cubits long.

cards.card_text: The whole area is five hundred cubits on every side, with a wall all the way around it.
cards.verse_text: It had a wall all around, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.
cards.snippet: It had a wall all around, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the…

cards.card_text: Then the voice gives the altar's measurements in long cubits: a gutter at the base, ledges stepping up, a square hearth twelve cubits each way with four horns, and steps facing east.
cards.verse_text: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits (a cubit and a handbreadth): Its gutter shall be a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around its edge.
cards.snippet: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits (a cubit and a handbreadth): Its gutter shall be a cubit deep…

cards.card_text: It's 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 wide, and friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, so I don't even know what to DO with that much room.
cards.verse_text: “When you divide the land by lot as an inheritance, you are to set aside a portion for the LORD, a holy portion of the land 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide.
cards.snippet: …a portion for the LORD, a holy portion of the land 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide.

cards.card_text: Inside that area, the sanctuary gets a square 500 cubits on each side, with 50 cubits of open land around it.
cards.verse_text: Within this area there is to be a section for the sanctuary 500 cubits square, with 50 cubits around it for open land.
cards.snippet: …this area there is to be a section for the sanctuary 500 cubits square, with 50 cubits around it for open land.

cards.card_text: He measures off a thousand cubits and leads Ezekiel right through the water.
cards.verse_text: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through ankle-deep water.
cards.snippet: …with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through ankle-deep water.

cards.card_text: After the man's first thousand cubits, how deep is it?
cards.verse_text: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through ankle-deep water.
cards.snippet: …with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through ankle-deep water.

cards.card_text: The man measures another thousand cubits, and the water is at Ezekiel's knees.
cards.verse_text: Then he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through knee-deep water.
cards.snippet: Then he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through knee-deep water.

cards.card_text: True or false: After the man measures one more thousand cubits, the water is too deep for Ezekiel to cross on foot.
cards.verse_text: Once again he measured off a thousand cubits, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because the water had risen and was deep enough for swimming—a river that could not be crossed on foot.
cards.snippet: Once again he measured off a thousand cubits, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because…

cards.card_text: Part of it is a holy portion for the priests, 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 wide.
cards.verse_text: The special portion you set apart to the LORD shall be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.
cards.snippet: The special portion you set apart to the LORD shall be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.

cards.card_text: Put the holy portion and the city land together and you get a square, 25,000 cubits by 25,000 cubits.
cards.verse_text: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits by 25,000 cubits.
cards.snippet: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits by 25,000 cubits.

cards.card_text: The city's perimeter runs 18,000 cubits.
cards.verse_text: The perimeter of the city will be 18,000 cubits, and from that day on the name of the city will be: THE LORD IS THERE.”
cards.snippet: The perimeter of the city will be 18,000 cubits, and from that day on the name of the city will be:…

cards.card_text: King Nebuchadnezzar's golden statue is ___ cubits high.
cards.verse_text: King Nebuchadnezzar made a golden statue sixty cubits high and six cubits wide, and he set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.
cards.snippet: King Nebuchadnezzar made a golden statue sixty cubits high and six cubits wide, and he set it up on the…

cards.card_text: Twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.
cards.verse_text: “I see a flying scroll,” I replied, “twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”
cards.snippet: “I see a flying scroll,” I replied, “twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”
